items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: One guy on a show the other day said...

ctx.x: My lifestyle has to somehow fit that.

One guy on a show the other day said if someone came to you and said we'll support you for the next year and a half or two years to write an opera, would you do it, hypothetically, and I thought and I said yeah, I would do it, I'd take a shot at it. If it were presented that way. I don't know if I could pull it off, but I certainly would try. I would want to do something like that now.
All my life I wished I could get in a situation where I didn't have to worry about (inaudible). I never wanted to be rich or powerful, that was never part of the plan, but I always did want to live.
